# ANSUL Fire Protection

> > ANSUL, a Johnson Controls brand, provides specialized fire suppression and detection systems for industrial, commercial, and vehicle applications worldwide.

ANSUL manufactures FM-approved fire protection solutions including the A-101 and R-102 suppression systems, serving industries from mining and construction to restaurant and commercial kitchens. The company operates ANSUL Fire School for training and certification.

## Key Topics

- A-101 Fire Suppression System
- R-102 Restaurant System
- Vehicle fire suppression
- Dry chemical suppression agents
- FORAY gaseous suppression
- CHECKFIRE detection systems
- FM Approved systems
- Mining equipment protection
- Mobile equipment fire safety
- Commercial kitchen fire suppression
- LVS (Low-pressure Vehicle System)
- ANSUL Fire School
- Industrial fire protection
- Automatic fire detection
- ActivFire technology

## Vehicle Fire Suppression Systems

- [Vehicle Fire Protection Systems](https://www.ansul.com/vehicle-fire-protection-systems): Fire detection & suppression for heavy-duty mobile equipment & vehicles
- [Vehicle Fire Suppression Systems](https://www.ansul.com/vehicle-fire-protection-systems/vehicle-fire-suppression-systems): Vehicle fire suppression: A-101, N-101, NF-40 LVS for industrial equipment
- [A-101 Vehicle Suppression System](https://www.ansul.com/vehicle-fire-protection-systems/a-101-fire-suppression-system/a101_vehicle_suppression_system_fsp/a-101-vehicle-suppression-system): A-101 dry chemical fire suppression system for mining & construction vehicles

## Restaurant & Commercial Kitchen Systems

- [Restaurant Systems](https://www.ansul.com/restaurant-systems): Restaurant & commercial kitchen fire suppression systems including R-102
